item.title: BlackRock Buys $896.5M in Bitcoin and Ethereum
item.summary: BlackRock has made substantial purchases of Bitcoin and Ethereum this week, committing a combined $896.5 million to the two leading cryptocurrencies as institutional interest in digital assets continues to build. The investment manager purchased approximately $693.5 million worth of Bitcoin and $203 million worth of Ethereum, according to the reported figures.
